notes.title: FREE DEMO @ NEXT FEST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575782/e64ab44f4b26492fc6f89c18202bcc17e27cc399.png[/img]
Hear ye, hear ye, noble subjects of the realm! I, King Qwerty, am delighted to announce the grand arrival of Qwerty Quest, a typing competition masterpiece created by the ingenious Shawn Kilian. Experience its glory for free during the Steam Next Fest Demo, from June 19th to June 26th!

Prepare yourselves, for on June 29th, this enchanting game shall be released at the meager price of $4.99, with a princely discount of 50% off, making it a mere $2.49! Such generosity befits a noble ruler, don't you agree?

Know that this labor of love consumed an entire year of my royal existence. With the mighty Unity 3D and the Playmaker visual scripting tool, I conjured this marvel. Countless assets from the Unity Asset Store adorned its virtual landscape.

Behold, fellow players! Strive to surpass my own highest score, for as the game's developer, I present the most formidable boss of all! Will you defeat me, your royal adversary, and claim the title of typing champion?

Prepare your fingers, steady your keystrokes, and embrace the excitement that awaits. Qwerty Quest beckons you to prove your typing prowess!

But our quest is not complete without your support! Leave your mark upon the kingdom of Steam by sharing your reviews and spreading word of our triumphs far and wide. Unite with your family and friends, let social media resound with tales of our adventure!

Marvel at the wonders that await! Qwerty Quest offers 8 characters and 8 challenging difficulties. With over 50 unique creatures lurking within 5 diverse environments, our journey promises endless excitement and discovery.

Together, let our voices echo through the realms, proclaiming the splendor of Qwerty Quest. With your support, we shall forge a legacy worthy of remembrance! #QwertyQuest #SteamNextFest #ReviewsAndSharing

-King Qwerty, Leader of the Kingdom of Knowledge
www.shawnkilian.com

notes.title: Encrypted Save Files!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575782/18bc507cc58f72630ee22abc0ea23950de9f9c5e.jpg[/img]
We've locked it down like a Wordemon in a bad Dream!
Thanks to a Unity Asset Store asset called Easy Save 3, I was able to add locally encrypted save files and link that up to Steam Cloud saves.  This prevents two big problems:
1) Cheaters who manipulate the plaintext save file to unlock infinite gold, characters or levels
2) Loss of saved files when moving to a new PC

Currently not supporting cross-platform Cloud Saves until the game becomes more popular.  At that point, I'll release a MAC version of the game and integrate Cloud Saves on an OS basis.

Something really cool about this update is the game remembers the character you were playing last, the level you were attempting last, and the gold you had when you last played.

Thank you for playing!

Shawn Kilian
Game Developer & Ultra Marathoner

notes.title: All difficulties implemented!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575782/58179c00d7b3a560a1f0a1b408f6d2eff6752df9.jpg[/img]
[previewyoutube=FyLWUMYQ8dY;full][/previewyoutube]

This update took me nearly 2 weeks to pull off without breaking the entire game in the process.  I not only added 4 additional difficulties, but I had to also do the following:
[list]
[*] Re-scale Enemy HP and Damage for all 50 creatures
[*] Balance enemy typing speed, especially the easiest difficulty (1 letter every 10 seconds)
[*] Progression Maps for all new difficulties
[/list]
Even I struggle with Myrmidon mode, and I am an expert typist.  I believe the game is balanced now.  What difficulty did you fit into?  Were you surprised?

Shawn Kilian
Game Developer & Ultramarathoner

notes.title: Added BONUS GOLD 💰 rewards for every victory or defeat!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575782/3ae4ee42d4a2e70c3f07c2db58621161b7627dea.jpg[/img]
[previewyoutube=4UCQ3qI9VZg;full][/previewyoutube]

The After Action Report now clearly shows your bonus gold earnings with a large "BONUS GOLD" coin at the screen's center, displaying the exact amount earned.

Bonus Gold formula:

Death: Word Count x Creature Count + Random (1-11) = Total Bonus Gold
Success: Word Count x Creature Count + Random (24-99) = Total Bonus Gold
More risk in success, but greater rewards! Spend gold on extra lives (from RIP the Reaper) or Wordslayers.

The report also shows your Wildwords stats - both yours and the enemy's. These little battle insights motivate me to boost my typing skills.

Thoughts on the update? Share in the comments!

notes.title: 🚨 Only 10 seconds to revive with RIP the Reaper!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575782/25fe767e278c73efb29a8ad022eff61e585143ba.jpg[/img]
[previewyoutube=iIXVautlHH4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Struggling to stay alive on a difficult level?[/b] [i] No worries! [/i] RIP the Reaper is here to save the day...but at a price, of course!  He simply wants 100 gold and he will revive you on the spot!  Die again?  No problem.  Just give him another 100 gold.

You have 10 seconds to decide.  He's pretty impatient.  He has other clients so he can't stick around too long.  If you don't decide within 10 seconds, you die and save your gold for another attempt.  You could also save your gold to purchase additional Wordslayers in the store.

Try the free demo today!  I would LOVE to hear your feedback.  Press F12 in game or leave a comment here so I can make Qwerty Quest the best it can possibly be.

Thank you!

Sincerely,

Shawn Kilian
Game Developer & Ultra Marathoner

In an effort to make sure the user understands how much of the game they have left to complete, I have added Dragons and Chests to each Qwerty Quest.  

If you see a Dragon/Chest, that means you have not completed that Qwerty Quest yet.
If the Dragon/Chest is gone, that means you have completed that Qwerty Quest.
You can still replay the levels as much as you like to farm gold and gems or reach a new high score.

What do you think of the dragons and the chest on the Map Selection Screen?

Shawn Kilian

notes.title: Qwerty Quest Official Video Game Trailer!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KyPGVYT.jpg[/img]
[previewyoutube=hLgfbh-KG0s;full][/previewyoutube]
It's that time!  The Official Qwerty Quest video game trailer has been released for all to enjoy!  If you are new to Qwerty Quest, it's a typing competition video game primarily targeted at younger audiences who are learning to type but it's also suitable for expert typists (like myself!) who want a real challenge and enjoy climbing the leaderboard to the top.

A little about the game =)

"Once upon a time, in a far-off land, a dreadful Curse of Silence fell upon the Kingdom of Knowledge. It rendered everyone mute. No one could speak, and no sound could be heard.

The wise king knew that something had to be done to break the curse. He consulted the most learned scholars in the land, who determined that the curse had been brought upon the kingdom by four fearsome creatures known as the Wordragons. 

The warriors knew that they had to act fast, for the fate of their kingdom was at stake. They drew their swords and charged at the Wordragons, fighting with all their might!  One by one, the Wordslayers recovered the stolen magical gems from each of the Wordragons.  The Curse of Silence was lifted from the Kingdom of Knowledge and the people could speak once again!"

CHOOSE YOUR WORDSLAYER
LEO the Legendary roars into battle with superior health
ARI the Accurate delivers deadly critical strikes
REX the Rager is hungry for a delicious lifetap
BOB the Berserker becomes enraged when near death
IVY the Insane blasts enemies with a stunning scream
SID the Sniper stings the nostrils with stinky cheese
LIZ the Limitless grows a new tail with regeneration
OZI dives in with a cyclone spin

CHOOSE YOUR DIFFICULTY
Sir (3-letter words every 3 seconds) A leisurely adventure for new recruits
Lord (4-letter words every 2 seconds) A modest challenge for experienced Lords
Guard (5-letter words every 1 second) A difficult endeavor for Royal Guards
Knight (6-letter words every 0.5 seconds) A raid that only seasoned Knights can survive
Paladin (7-letter words every 0.35 seconds) A crusade for courageous and noble Paladins
Myrmidon (8-letter words every 0.25 seconds) A brave conquest for the most fearsome Warriors
Gladiator (9-letter words every 0.20 seconds) An epic quest to impress the King in solo combat
Invincible (10-letter words every 0.15 seconds) A campaign to eradicate evil once and for all

CHOOSE YOUR MAP
Wilds  = 9 enemies + 1 Wild Wordragon = Emerald
Tundra = 9 enemies + 1 Ice Wordragon = Sapphire
Abyss  = 9 enemies + 1 Lava Wordragon = Ruby
Crypt  = 9 enemies + 1 Ancient Wordragon = Diamond
Defeat all four Wordragons to collect an Emerald, Sapphire, Ruby, and Diamond to beat the game!

WILDWORDS
Fire - Crashes a fiery meteor from the sky
Germ - Launches a poisonous gas cloud
Gold - Steals a random gold amount
Heal - Instantly restores health
Bolt - Unleashes a powerful lightning bolt
Time - Slows down time by 50%

LEADERBOARDS
The score is based on the following formula:
Word Length x Score Multiplier = Total Score

STORE
Gold, Emeralds, Sapphires, Rubies, and Diamonds are used to unlock new Wordslayers and additional lives

FREE FOR SCHOOLS AND TEACHERS!
